title: Verdant Ruins: The Diplomat's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the mutual passage covenant; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
